_about: Every agent as people meet them. Display only: no prompt carries these names. Copied to frontend/src/lib/agent-personas.json (a test keeps the two the same).

smith.name: Smith
smith.title: The architect you talk to
smith.intro: I'm Smith. You tell me what you want and I turn it into a plan the team builds, then I change the app whenever you ask — and I check that it works before I say it's done.

requirement.name: Rita
requirement.title: Requirements analyst
requirement.intro: I'm Rita. I write down what the app is for: who uses it, what each of them needs to do, and the rules it has to follow. Everyone else builds from my list.

domain_intelligence.name: Dana
domain_intelligence.title: Domain researcher
domain_intelligence.intro: I'm Dana. I know how businesses like yours usually work — the records they keep, the steps they follow — so the app doesn't miss what people in your line of work expect.

product_analysis.name: Priya
product_analysis.title: Product analyst
product_analysis.intro: I'm Priya. I turn the requirements into the shape of the product: its modules, who each one is for, and what has to be built first.

solution_architecture.name: Arjun
solution_architecture.title: Solution architect
solution_architecture.intro: I'm Arjun. I map the app's screens and how people move between them, so every role has a way in and nothing is left unreachable.

integration.name: Ivan
integration.title: Integrations engineer
integration.intro: I'm Ivan. I connect the app to the outside world — email, payments, other systems' APIs and webhooks — and check each connection actually answers.

accessibility.name: Iris
accessibility.title: Design system lead
accessibility.intro: I'm Iris. I own the app's look: its colours, type, spacing and imagery, and I keep it readable for everyone.

page_design.name: Paige
page_design.title: Page designer
page_design.intro: I'm Paige. For every page I decide what it shows, who it's for and what people can do there — the contract the builders work to.

figma_intelligence.name: Felix
figma_intelligence.title: Design reader
figma_intelligence.intro: I'm Felix. When you bring a Figma file or a UX Pilot design, I read it and hand the team the screens, components and tokens it holds.

ui_director.name: Uma
ui_director.title: Design director
ui_director.intro: I'm Uma. I set the conventions the whole app shares — how pages open, where actions go, how dense things are — so it feels like one product.

data_model.name: Bob
data_model.title: Data modeller
data_model.intro: I'm Bob. I design the records the app keeps and how they connect, and I write the sample data you see before your own arrives.

api.name: Ada
api.title: API designer
api.intro: I'm Ada. I derive the app's endpoints from the data model, so every screen and process has a way to read and save what it needs.

backend.name: Kai
backend.title: Backend engineer
backend.intro: I'm Kai. I project the data model into the database and the server code that keeps it.

analytics.name: Ana
analytics.title: Analytics designer
analytics.intro: I'm Ana. I design the numbers and charts each page carries — what is counted, summed and compared — and make sure they come from real records.

page_template.name: Theo
page_template.title: Layout engineer
page_template.intro: I'm Theo. I lay out each page from its contract, so it opens the way the design director set and shows what the page designer asked for.

ui_engineer.name: Leo
ui_engineer.title: UI engineer
ui_engineer.intro: I'm Leo. I write pages in React when a layout isn't enough, and I don't hand one over until it compiles.

frontend.name: Fern
frontend.title: Frontend engineer
frontend.intro: I'm Fern. I turn the page designs into the schemas and files the running app renders.

native_engineer.name: Nina
native_engineer.title: Mobile engineer
native_engineer.intro: I'm Nina. When the app goes on a phone, I write its screens for Expo and keep them in step with the web pages.

workflow.name: Todd
workflow.title: Workflow engineer
workflow.intro: I'm Todd. I wire up the app's processes step by step — what happens when someone submits, approves or cancels — and the formulas inside them.

business_rules.name: Ruth
business_rules.title: Business rules analyst
business_rules.intro: I'm Ruth. I write the app's rules — limits, required fields, who may do what when — and keep each one in a single place the whole app follows.

security.name: Sam
security.title: Security officer
security.intro: I'm Sam. I set the roles and permissions: who can see and change which records, and who reviews what is audited.

verification.name: Vera
verification.title: Verifier
verification.intro: I'm Vera. I check the blueprint against itself — every reference resolves, every control does what it says — before anything is built.

memory.name: Mo
memory.title: Record keeper
memory.intro: I'm Mo. I keep the record of every decision and what each requirement is covered by, so a change later knows why things are the way they are.

observer.name: Otto
observer.title: Reviewer
observer.intro: I'm Otto. I read each piece of work the moment it lands and send it back to whoever made it when it isn't right.

page_reviewer.name: Penny
page_reviewer.title: Page reviewer
page_reviewer.intro: I'm Penny. I open each page as the people it's for, look at it the way they would, and send weak ones back to be redone.

testing.name: Tess
testing.title: App tester
testing.intro: I'm Tess. When the app is built I use every page as every role — pressing the buttons, following the flows — and report what doesn't work.

process_trials.name: Trey
process_trials.title: Process tester
process_trials.intro: I'm Trey. I run each of the app's processes for real on a copy of its data and check that what it saved shows up where people look for it.

build.name: Bruno
build.title: Build engineer
build.intro: I'm Bruno. I assemble the app, install what it needs and start it, so there's a running preview to try.

deployment.name: Dex
deployment.title: Release engineer
deployment.intro: I'm Dex. I publish the app — its database, its address and its settings — and only say it's live once it answers.

a2ui_pages.name: Abe
a2ui_pages.title: Page composer
a2ui_pages.intro: I'm Abe. I compose pages from the component library when Smith changes a screen that is built from parts rather than code.

researcher.name: Remy
researcher.title: Researcher
researcher.intro: I'm Remy. In the Drafts Room I study the references you point me at — sites, screenshots, documents — and bring back what they do well.
